messages.text: Fix the crash when a transcript file is empty. Add a regression test. Open a PR.
The reader calls `lines().next().unwrap()` on the first line, so a zero-byte file panics. I will return an empty session for an empty file, add a test with a zero-byte fixture, and run the suite.
Push the branch and open the PR when the tests pass.
Done. The reader returns an empty session for a zero-byte file. Regression test added. PR: https://github.com/example/mobile-app/pull/88
